artifacts.title: Biese et al. v. Tennessee Valley Presbytery
artifacts.synopsis: Tennessee Valley Presbytery approved without exception Session minutes planning a youth group Super Bowl Party on Sunday; the SJC denied the complaint because the record was insufficient to find Presbytery erred in its constitutional interpretation. A dissent by RE Eggert argued the complaint was judicially out of order because the SJC lacks constitutional authority to review a presbytery's session-records review decisions under BCO 40-2 and 40-3.

artifacts.synopsis: REs Martinez and Cook complained that Pacific Presbytery erred by tasking its Shepherding Committee to follow up with Valley Presbyterian Church's Session after a dispute about doxologies in worship, alleging this exceeded Presbytery's jurisdictional authority. The SJC denied the complaint on Issue 1 (finding no BCO violation in the visitation itself) but sustained it on Issue 2, concluding Presbytery made clear errors of judgment by sending the Shepherding Committee without sufficiently clear instructions or adequate notice.

artifacts.title: Bethel v. Southeast Alabama Presbytery
artifacts.synopsis: The SJC ruled Case 2012-06 administratively out of order on two grounds: the complaint was not filed within the required 30-day period under BCO 43-2, and the complainant (a deacon who was not a commissioner to presbytery on the date of the action complained against) lacked standing under BCO 43-1.

artifacts.title: Presbytery membership of a church outside its geographic bounds

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a presbytery does not have constitutional authority under BCO 13-1 to include as a member a church located outside its bounds.

artifacts.title: Whether a ruling elder moderator must also hold a representative commission

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a non-representative ruling elder may serve as presbytery moderator, but may only vote when his vote would be determinative.

artifacts.title: Constitutionality of a non-geographical presbytery under BCO 11-4

matches.evidence: The CCB found that the BCO does not address non-geographical presbyteries, as BCO 11-4 implies geographical bounds while BCO 13-1 does not limit 'bounds' geographically.
